summary: A 5-inch freestyle FPV quadcopter on 6S power, built from purchased modules on a custom true-X frame, with a digital video link, an ExpressLRS radio link, and GNSS with a compass.
features: True-X 5-inch frame, custom, 225 mm wheelbase, with at least 5 mm of prop clearance
6S LiPo power: CNHL 1100 mAh 100C pack, DolphinRC F405 V3 + AM32 60A stack, MEPS NEON 2207 V2 1950KV motors, HQProp Ethix S5 props
DJI O4 Air Unit digital video with the flight controller's OSD
Purchased modules and an existing flight-control stack: no PCB or flight-algorithm development

functions.text: Fly under radio control: the flight controller reads the pilot's sticks over the ExpressLRS link and drives the four motors through the ESC
functions.by: RadioMaster RP1 V2, DolphinRC F405 V3, AM32 60A 4-in-1 ESC, MEPS NEON 2207 motors

functions.text: Send live digital video to the goggles, with the flight controller's OSD over it
Report GNSS position and compass heading to the flight controller
Power everything from one 6S LiPo pack
functions.by: CNHL Black Series 1100 mAh 6S, XT60 lead, bulk capacitor
